# Visionary Sound Productions

> Owner-operated event production company founded in 2004 by Aaron Barris, based in Commerce Township, Michigan. Full-service lighting, sound, video, staging, and AV installation for weddings, bar/bat mitzvahs, corporate events, school events, and concerts. Serves Metro Detroit and the Midwest, with nationwide service on request.

## About

Visionary Sound Productions (VSP) has serviced thousands of events since 2004. Aaron Barris — owner, lead designer, and the direct point of contact — has been featured in PLSN's Showtime section 25 times and in Mobile Beat and Lighting & Sound America. Crews scale from 2 to 40+ depending on event size, and many clients have worked with VSP for more than a decade. Pricing is fixed-price by proposal, and the owner answers the phone directly.

## Services

- [Event Production](https://visionarysoundproductions.com/event-production): Stage, lighting, sound, and video for corporate galas, school assemblies, nonprofit fundraisers, and concerts — scoped, designed, built, and run by VSP's own crew.
- [Weddings](https://visionarysoundproductions.com/weddings): Décor lighting, dance floors, sound systems, and special effects designed to match the venue and the vibe.
- [Bar & Bat Mitzvahs](https://visionarysoundproductions.com/mitzvahs): From intimate to full production, built around the family's concept.
- [AV Installation](https://visionarysoundproductions.com/av-installation): Permanent audio/video systems for venues and institutions.
- [Equipment Rentals](https://visionarysoundproductions.com/rentals): LED walls, line arrays, moving lights, staging, and DJ-grade gear.
- [Services overview](https://visionarysoundproductions.com/services)
